policy: English mode: zero pending translation rows for audited base scripts and installed plugins/BSS/SDS. ZBox events remain excluded.
upgradeMigration: Empty English rows are filled from the seed.
Old English rows whose Text was just the Spanish source are replaced by the completed English seed.
Known reverse-direction ZBox rows and known mismatched older mappings are repaired on load.
notes: Base scripts use the user-supplied English Data as primary reference and strict structural source matching where possible.
DBK/EUI/Raid/EBDX/SOS plugin text uses the supplied English plugin packs wherever a safe source pair exists.
Project-only custom Spanish strings are explicitly localized rather than left as pending.
Source literals already written in English are explicitly marked complete.
Events are never imported from ZBox/reference packs.
